name: Manual Legacy Fleet - All Start Years
description: Shows Manual build of legacy fleet for every native start year: 1890, 1900, 1920 and 1935. Uses the selected start year minus one for initial fleet design instead of forcing 1899. Manual construction remains optional; its native prestige and starting-fleet funding penalties remain. Changes apply to new campaigns only. Use a test slot; full new-campaign gameplay validation is outstanding. In a 1920 start the checkbox sits below the arms-limitation treaty list instead of on top of its title.
